programs.title: KOICA Youth Leaders Program 2026 to 2027
programs.overview: Leadership and digital innovation training for African youth in three phases: online, in Ghana, then South Korea. The call targeted five West African countries and did not include the DRC.
programs.program_dates: Online 20 to 31 July 2026; Ghana 2 to 29 August 2026; South Korea June 2027
funding_details: Accommodation and meals during the local and Korean phases were reported as covered.
nationality_requirements: Ghana, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria and Senegal
eligibility: Active in the public, private or academic sector
From one of the five target countries
potential_issues: Not open to DRC nationals in this edition
programs.action: No action: the DRC was not a target country.

programs.title: McKinsey.org Forward learning programme (Fall 2026)
programs.overview: Free multi-week online programme teaching practical workplace skills: adaptability, communication, problem-solving, and digital and AI essentials. Applications are open until 5 October.
programs.program_dates: Multi-week programme following the application window
programs.deadline_text: Fall 2026 call closed on 5 October 2026. FAQ on 12 October 2026: 'Applications are not open at the moment. However, you can still register your interest ... to be the first to receive email notifications when a new application cycle opens in your country.'
programs.expected_next_cycle: Next cohort not announced; the Forward overview page (read 19 October 2026) invites people to 'Register your interest' and 'be the first to get notified when applications reopen in your country'.
funding_details: 'Forward is a free multi-week learning program'
programs.participation_fee: None: 'Forward is free for eligible participants ... There are no fees to apply, register, or partake' (official FAQ).
programs.experience_requirement: Reported: under 5 years of work experience; internships count
programs.language_requirement: Primarily English; a secondary source says the digital content is also translated into French
eligibility: Live in a country where Forward is available; the FAQ's Africa list includes the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Working or with prior work experience (including internships or apprenticeships), or preparing to start work in the next 12 months
Less than 5 years of total work experience (exceptions stated for nonprofit, non-corporate or non-managerial roles)
At least a high school education or equivalent
Command of English, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish or Arabic
application_process: Apply online from the Forward overview page before 5 October

sources.label: McKinsey.org Forward FAQ (deadline, eligibility, country list, no fees)

potential_issues: Closed on 5 October 2026; next cohort not announced
benefits: Skills that employers in the target roles ask for
programs.action: Register interest on the McKinsey.org Forward page to be told when the next cycle opens.
